run_translation_generation: run the fairseq generate CLI to translate pre-processed data with a trained model
run_beam_search_decoding: run beam search decoding on a dataset using a loaded fairseq model ensemble
run_language_model_scoring: run language model assisted generation by loading an external LM and weighting hypotheses
run_alignment_output: run generation with hard or soft alignment output printed for each hypothesis
run_bleu_scoring: run generation and compute BLEU scores against target translations using the built-in scorer
